mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood was most worthwhile because the picture clearly distinguished what enters the tubule from what stays in the blood; the following recovery steps showed why filtering is only part of the process.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was straightforward, but the two separate fittings added little decision-making.

surprise.text: The recovery of almost all filtered glucose in healthy kidneys clarified that useful substances initially pass through the filter too.

arbitrary.text: The urinary drainage piece and the fitted ureters and bladder seemed to represent the same route separately. Their roles in the two constructions were understandable, though the separation felt somewhat artificial.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter: the filtering and recovery sequence connected cellular transport to an organ's job clearly, though the straightforward fittings were less engaging.
